info.name: Khoj — real verification call
info.description:
End-to-end test of the Khoj backend against a real CALL-E call.

Before you start, set the collection variable `phone_e164` to YOUR OWN mobile in E.164 form (+91 then 10 digits). Step 4 dials it for real: it costs CALL-E credits and rings an actual phone, so point it at yourself first and at broker numbers only once the round trip works.

Run the requests in order. Step 2 saves `session_id` into a collection variable automatically, so nothing has to be copied by hand.

Auth: none. The local .env sets AUTH_REQUIRED=false. Against a deployed backend with AUTH_REQUIRED=true you must add `Authorization: Bearer <Firebase ID token>` to every request except Health.

variable.description: Local server. Use https://khoj-zgkq.onrender.com for the deployed one.
YOUR mobile. This number gets called for real in step 4.

request.description: Confirm before spending a call. You want database_connected true, telephony 'calle', llm_configured true, calle_configured true, and call_windows_enforced false (otherwise a call outside 11:00-13:00 or 17:00-20:00 IST is deferred, not dialled, and looks broken when it is not).

exec: console.warn('Call windows are ON — a call outside 11:00-13:00 / 17:00-20:00 IST will be deferred. Set IGNORE_CALL_WINDOW=true to test now.');

item.name: 2. Start a search (nothing is dialled yet)

request.description:
`pasted_content` skips crawling entirely, which is the path that works when a portal hides its phone numbers behind a login. Gemini extracts the listing from this text — including the contact number, which is what makes it dialable in step 4.

`auto_call` stays false so you choose when the phone rings.

Returns 202 with session_id, the parsed criteria, your tier, and the listings limit.

exec: console.log('session_id =', b.session_id, '| tier', b.tier, '| limit', b.listings_limit);
console.error('phone_e164 is still the placeholder — set it to your real number before step 4.');

request.description:
Send this until session.status is 'ranked' — usually a few seconds while Gemini extracts and the listings are ordered.

Check `listings[0].contact_number` is populated before step 4. If it is null the model did not find a number in the pasted text, and call-all will return 409 with nothing to dial. Fix that by making the number more explicit in step 2 rather than by retrying.

exec: pm.test('at least one listing has a number to dial', () => pm.expect(dialable.length).to.be.above(0));
console.log('not ranked yet — send this request again');

query.description: Hard cap. Keep at 1 so exactly one call is placed.

request.description:
This places a REAL outbound call through CALL-E. It costs credits and rings a real phone.

limit=1 caps it at one call, and MAX_CALLS_PER_SESSION=2 in .env is a second backstop.

Answer as a broker would. Quote a HIGHER rent than the 22,000 in the advert — then the honesty evaluator has a genuine discrepancy to catch in step 5, which is the whole point of the product.

409 means no listing had a phone number: go back to step 3 and check contact_number.
402 means the plan's verification quota is used up.

exec: console.log('queued =', b.queued, '| tier', b.tier, '| remaining after', b.remaining_after);
if (pm.response.code === 409) console.error('Nothing dialable — check listings[].contact_number in step 3.');
if (pm.response.code === 402) console.error('Quota exhausted for this plan.');

request.description:
Send once the call has ended.

Each entry carries the listing, the call with its transcript and question/answer pairs, and the honesty report: honesty_score, final_verdict, red_flags, and listing_discrepancies comparing what the advert claimed against what was actually said on the phone.

An answer is only recorded when the model can quote the broker verbatim — a quote that is not literally in the transcript is discarded rather than shown.

exec: if (!r) { console.log('no results yet — the call may still be running'); return; }
